judgment_refs.phrase: place marked as a freight curb loading zone during hours when the provisions applicable to such zones are in effect
judgment_refs.note: Authored marking and sign do not establish regulatory authority; original civil time and sign hours are source reviewed.

judgment_refs.phrase: expeditious unloading and delivery or pickup and loading of materials
judgment_refs.note: Prop motion is a request; independent original activity and duration review is needed without a numeric legal cutoff.

judgment_refs.phrase: stop temporarily ... while actually engaged in loading or unloading passengers
judgment_refs.note: Door and walker commands do not prove actual exchange or temporary legal character.

judgment_refs.phrase: does not interfere with any motor vehicle used for the transportation of materials which is waiting to enter or about to enter such zone
judgment_refs.note: Waiting state, vehicle class and physical interference need independent original spatial-temporal review.

sweep_specs.rationale: Five controlled requests expose source conditions; no original legal threshold or physical interference result is established.
